category.reason: The task requires identifying the relevant app category and ranking multiple visible download counts before selecting an entry.

instruction.en: Browse the game app with the second-highest download count.
instruction.zh: 浏览下载量第二高的游戏类应用。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the revised English instruction. The original instruction requested the mobile version of the League of Legends auto-chess game, but the screenshot does not establish that franchise relationship. Revised the instruction to request the game app with the second-highest download count, requiring comparison of the displayed game apps rather than external franchise knowledge. 金铲铲之战 shows 85.61 million downloads and 捕鱼大作战-高爆率 shows 35.65 million, making the latter the target. Changed groundTruth from [1064.2, 845.0, 1257.3, 33.0] to [1460.0, 1030.0, 1653.0, 33.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, moving it from the original 金铲铲之战 card to the 捕鱼大作战-高爆率 row, including its icon, details, and Install button. Updated category.reason to describe the game identification and download-count comparison.
